headline: UN Security Council Renews Colombia Peace Mission Without Rural Reform Oversight
summary: The United Nations Security Council unanimously renewed the mandate of the Verification Mission for the Peace Agreement in Colombia through October 31, 2027, while removing oversight of the Comprehensive Rural Reform.
why: International peacekeeping mandates and political reforms in Colombia affect national stability, foreign investment risk, and sovereign debt perceptions.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Changes to the UN mission scope impact domestic political stability and policy implementation.
